description: The APO broad-band filter set contains standard optical imaging filters (Johnson-Cousins B, V, R, I and BG40) available for imaging instruments on the ARC 3.5-meter telescope.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical and infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in the Sacramento Mountains of New Mexico, owned and operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: Broad band filters (bandpass > 30 nm) in the APO pool. Numerical filter curves are hosted on NMSU/APO pages without an open redistribution licence.
